Plan, write, and structure your website before you build it.

The Website Blueprint Kit by VelvetDigitalLabb is the ultimate workbook to turn your ideas into a solid, launch-ready web project. Designed for freelancers, small business owners, and web designers, this kit guides you through the entire website creation process—from defining your ideal client to post-launch optimization.

WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE:
• A fully editable 31-page Canva template (A4 size).
• 3 Complete Aesthetic Editions to match your vibe: Classic (warm tones), Light (bright & clean), and Dark (sleek & moody).

products.details:
KNOW YOUR REAL PROFIT ON EVERY SALE

Selling a lot but not sure what you actually keep? The Seller Profit System is a spreadsheet that works out every Etsy fee on every sale, shows what is really left after your costs, and tells you the price you need to charge to earn the profit you want.

Works for digital and physical products. No macros, no add-ons, no subscription.

WHAT YOU GET
• 11 tabs: Dashboard, Price Calculator, Products, Sales Log, Expenses, Listings, Monthly, Tax & Goals, Settings, Fee Sheet and a Start Here page
• A BLANK workbook for your shop and a DEMO workbook filled with a fictional shop, so you can see it working first
• Customer guide (PDF, 14 pages), step by step for Mac and Windows
• Instant download

WHAT IT DOES
• Calculates the fees on every sale you log: transaction fee, payment processing (percent plus fixed fee), listing fee, Offsite Ads (with the cap), currency conversion and the regulatory operating fee for your country
• Shows your net profit per sale, per product and per month, after fees, product costs, packaging and shipping labels
• Price Calculator: the minimum and suggested price that keeps your target margin, a price ladder, and a break-even helper for Etsy Ads
• Products tab flags any product priced too low, and the exact price to raise it to
• Dashboard: revenue, Etsy fees, net profit, profit per order, goal progress and four charts
• Listings tab: enter views, favorites and orders once a month and get one plain next step for each listing
• Tax and Goals: an estimate of what to set aside each quarter, and how many orders a week your goal needs
• Fee rates are on the Settings tab with their sources, so you can update them when Etsy changes them

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download your files from Etsy (use a web browser; the Etsy app doesn't offer downloads)
2. Open the BLANK workbook in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets
3. Type your shop name, your country's fee preset and your goals on the Settings tab
4. List your products, then log your sales and expenses as they happen (about a minute per order)
5. Open the Dashboard once a week and see where you really stand

WHO IT'S FOR
Etsy sellers of digital and physical products who want to price with confidence and know their real numbers: new shops, growing shops, and anyone tired of guessing.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Instant digital download. Nothing is shipped.
- You enter your sales and expenses yourself. The workbook does not connect to your Etsy shop.
- Fee rates were checked on etsy.com/legal/fees (updated 5 October 2026). Fees change and some depend on your country, so always check your own Etsy account. The regulatory operating fee is set to 0% until you enter yours.
- Sales tax, VAT and income tax are not calculated. The tax figure is a rough estimate based on a percentage you choose. This is not tax, legal or accounting advice.
- Capacity per copy: 200 products, 1,500 sales rows, 500 expenses, 200 listings. Start a fresh copy each year.
- Made for Excel and Google Sheets. Apple Numbers is not recommended.
- The DEMO shop in the screenshots is fictional. Results are not guaranteed: the workbook shows you your numbers, what you do with them is up to you.
- Licence: for your own shop and records. Reselling, sharing or uploading the file is not allowed.
- This is an independent tool, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Etsy, Inc.
